title: A2UI decision catalog pattern file
description: How one component catalog draws the abstract layout patterns named by the decision archetype grammar. Experimental and non-normative: the Python agent SDK (a2ui.inference_formats.decision) is the reference implementation. A catalog's pattern file is part of that catalog and must validate after any component change.

catalogId.description: The `catalogId` of the one catalog.json this file applies to. Keep one pattern file per catalog and protocol version.

grammarVersion.description: The `grammarVersion` of the archetype grammar these patterns target.

pattern.description: A catalog template definition for one abstract block pattern, with either a single component tree or knob-conditional variants.

slots.description: Names of the grammar slots (and block-level instance answers) consumed by this pattern.

knobs.description: Anatomy or measure names that this pattern varies by, mapped to the option values this catalog supports.

root.description: Local component id of the root component for this pattern.

variants.description: Knob-conditional component trees evaluated in order; a variant without `when` is the default fallback.

fieldVariants.description: Map of instance answer values to id-less component templates selected per element by `$byInstance`.

note.description: Informative note explaining catalog-specific rendering choices or omissions.

variant.description: One knob-conditional component tree for a pattern.

when.description: Knob name to the value or values that select this variant; a variant without `when` is the default.

root.description: Local component id of the root component for this variant.

note.description: Informative note explaining variant-specific rendering behavior.

componentList.description: Non-empty list of component templates forming a pattern or variant tree.

component.description: A component template with an id, expanded once per block (or once per element inside `$repeat`).

fieldVariant.description: An id-less component template selected by `$byInstance`; the expander assigns the id. A `fieldVariant` may either be a single inline component template or include an inline `child` or `children` array of id-less component definitions that the expander recursively hoists into the surface component list with generated ids.

templateValue.description: A JSON value inside a component template: a primitive literal, an array of template values, or a nested template object containing directives.

templateObject.description: Any JSON object; keys starting with `$` are template directives with the value shapes below.

slotDirective.description: Slot name (optionally `slot.field`); becomes a data binding to the bound pointer, or `$default` when unbound.

textDirective.description: Literal with `{slot}` placeholders; a bound slot becomes a formatString call, `{$index1}` is the 1-based element index.

defaultDirective.description: Literal used when the `$slot`, `$knobValue`, or `$event` beside it resolves to nothing.

ifDirective.description: Slot name; the component is emitted only when that slot is bound.

ifKnobDirective.description: Knob name to accepted values; the component is emitted only when every knob matches.

ifSelfDirective.description: Value (or child id) to use when the element's author is the `self` knob (`true`) or not (`false`).

ifInstanceDirective.description: Instance answer name to required value; the enclosing property is emitted only when each holds. When used inside a property value wrapper (`{"$ifInstance": {...}, "value": ...}` or inside `$switch` cases), the sibling `value` key holds the value emitted when the predicate matches.

byTypeDirective.description: Slot name; the sibling key matching the slot's semantic type names the child id to emit.

byInstanceDirective.description: Instance answer name; selects a `fieldVariants` entry, or a sibling key matching the answer.

repeatDirective.description: Repeated slot name; `children` becomes a template child list bound to the slot's array (sibling `component` names the template, and optional sibling `order` such as `"primaryLast"` controls element ordering).

mapDirective.description: Knob or instance answer name; the sibling key matching its value is the literal to emit.

eventDirective.description: A slot bound to an agent action id, which becomes the event name. When the slot is unbound, `$default` beside it is the literal event name (the slot name itself if there is no `$default`). Labels never become event names. Emits `{"event": {"name": ...}}` plus `context`.

blocksDirective.description: Placeholder in the page pattern's children for the block roots in archetype order.

knobValueDirective.description: `knob.property` lookup into the plan; `$default` applies when absent.

actionContextDirective.description: Inside an `$event` `context`, resolves to the action's own context pointers; else, inside `$repeat`, a binding to the current item's key field; else, for a form submit, every editable pointer of the block.
